resources.string: While the reader is on screen, ListenLock listens for \"ListenLock\" and a command: \"pause\", \"play\", \"next\", \"back\", \"repeat\", \"faster\" or \"slower\". Your phone\'s own speech recogniser does the listening, on the phone: nothing is recorded or sent, and there is nothing to download. Android shows the microphone indicator meanwhile. Uses some battery while it listens.
Not available: this phone has no on-device speech recogniser.
Keep listening with the screen off

plurals.name: commands_screen_off_body
plurals.item: While a book is open in the reader, ListenLock also listens with the screen off or in another app, and shows a notification you can stop it from. To save battery it stops once reading has been paused for %1$d minute and the reader is off screen.

While a book is open in the reader, ListenLock also listens with the screen off or in another app, and shows a notification you can stop it from. To save battery it stops once reading has been paused for %1$d minutes and the reader is off screen.

resources.string: Listening with the screen off needs notifications, so you can always see it and stop it. You can allow them in Android\'s app settings.
Voice commands need the microphone. You can allow it in Android\'s app settings.
Voice commands can\'t listen: allow the microphone in Android\'s app settings.
This phone has no on-device speech recogniser, so voice commands can\'t listen.
Your phone is downloading its English speech pack. Voice commands start once it\'s ready: open the book again then.
Another app is using the microphone, so voice commands can\'t listen.
The microphone stopped, so voice commands stopped. Open the book again to restart them.
